lines.text: Many learners say: I bought a bag new.
Better: I bought a new bag.
Red car! She has a red car.

native.tip: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kata sifat ada setelah benda: “tas baru”. Bahasa Inggris sebaliknya: new bag.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I bought a bag new.” 😅 Dalam bahasa Inggris, kata sifat ada di depan: “I bought a new bag.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “red car”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang barang barumu, misalnya: “I have a new phone.” Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: In Indonesian the describing word comes after the thing: “tas baru”. English is the opposite: new bag.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I bought a bag new.” 😅 In English, the describing word goes first: “I bought a new bag.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
